risks.name: Mud loss
reasons: All 3 most similar offsets lost mud within 20 m below the Barail top.
ECD 1.453 and rising 0.010 g/cm³ per hour toward the 1.52 fracture limit.
Flow out down 3 % and pit volume falling 0.4 m³/h over 40 min.

mitigations.text: 40 ppb LCM pill, flow cut 10 % · W-067, cured in 3.5 h
30 ppb fine LCM in the active system · W-042, 1 h
LCM pills alone · W-088, failed; cement plug, 36 h

risks.recommendation: Pre-treat with 30–40 ppb LCM and hold ECD below 1.47 g/cm³ before 3,180 m MD.

risks.name: Stuck pipe
reasons: W-121 stuck differentially 18 m below the Barail top on a connection.
W-042 pulled 25 t over at the same position in the formation.
Overbalance reaches about 16 bar at the top with 1.38 g/cm³ mud.

mitigations.text: Jarring and a pipe-free pill · W-121, 9 h

risks.recommendation: Keep connections short and the string moving below 3,186 m MD.

risks.name: Overpressure
reasons: W-112 took a 1.2 m³ gas influx at 3,510 m MD.
The zone sits beyond the current look-ahead window.
Only one offset supports this, so confidence is low.

mitigations.text: Shut in, circulated out, MW raised to 1.52 · W-112, 9 h

risks.recommendation: Review the mud-weight plan before 3,400 m MD.

risks.name: Torque spike
reasons: Torque is 3.1 kN·m above the torque-and-drag model.
W-067 had spikes in the Tipam and reamed through.

mitigations.text: Reduced WOB, 2 % lubricant · W-067, stable in 2 h

risks.recommendation: Watch the torque residual; add lubricant if it passes +5 kN·m.

risks.name: Wellbore instability
reasons: Barail shales swelled in W-132 and W-042 after long open-hole time.
Current mud inhibition matches the successful offsets.

mitigations.text: KCl-polymer mud kept inhibition · W-067, no issue

risks.recommendation: Limit open-hole time in the Barail; trip promptly after TD.

risks.name: Cementing
reasons: W-088 had a poor bond at its 9⅝-in shoe.
W-103 lost returns while cementing in the Barail.

mitigations.text: Squeeze job before drilling ahead · W-088, 1 day

risks.recommendation: Plan a lighter lead slurry for the 7-in liner at about 3,460 m MD.

model.note: Offset prior only; no live signal until the liner job.

risks.name: Kick
reasons: One offset influx, deep and far outside the current window.
Pit and flow trends show losses, not gains.

mitigations.text: Shut in and weight up · W-112, 9 h

risks.recommendation: No action now. Reassess at 3,400 m MD.

fields.label: OUTCOME
fields.reviewReason: Two numbers on one line; please confirm.

pageText: Well W-067 was drilling the 8½-in hole below the
9⅝-in shoe with KCl-polymer mud at 1.38 g/cm³.
At 3,061 m MD (3,021 m TVDSS), 17 m into the
Barail, partial losses of 45 bbl/hr were observed.
Flow rate was reduced by 10% and a 40 ppb LCM
pill was spotted across the loss zone.
Losses cured after 3.5 hrs; total mud lost 12 m³.

graph.evidencePathText: OIL-WELL-104 → W-067 → mud loss 17 m below the Barail top → 40 ppb LCM pill → cured in 3.5 h. Source: WCR W-067 p.47.

examples.question: What happened in nearby wells at the depth we are about to drill?
examples.answer: Three of the closest offsets had trouble within 20 m below the Barail top: two lost mud and one got stuck. OIL-WELL-104 reaches that zone in about 62 m.

evidence.text: W-067 lost 45 bbl/h at 3,061 m MD, 17 m below its Barail top
W-088 lost total returns 13 m below its Barail top
W-121 stuck differentially 17 m below its Barail top

examples.question: Why is the mud-loss risk 83 %?
examples.answer: The offsets most like this well all lost mud just below the Barail top, and the live data is starting to look like theirs did: ECD is rising and flow out is down 3 %.

evidence.text: All 3 top offsets lost mud within 20 m below the Barail top
evidence.source: WCR p.47 · WCR p.88 · DDR 2 Nov 2016

evidence.text: ECD 1.453 g/cm³, rising 0.010 per hour toward 1.52
Flow out −3 % and pit −0.4 m³/h over 40 min

examples.question: What worked when W-067 lost mud?
examples.answer: Cutting flow by 10 % and spotting a 40 ppb LCM pill cured it in 3.5 h with 12 m³ lost. W-088 tried pills alone at a higher ECD and needed a cement plug.

evidence.text: W-067: flow −10 %, 40 ppb LCM pill, cured in 3.5 h
W-042: 30 ppb fine LCM in the active system, cured in 1 h
W-088: two pills failed at ECD 1.478, cement plug, 36 h

examples.question: Compare OIL-WELL-104 with W-067.
examples.answer: Same mud system and bit, 87 % similar. OIL-WELL-104 is drilling 10 % slower with 12 % more torque, and its 9⅝-in shoe is 60 m deeper.
